'''Centro Desportivo de Fátima''', simply known as '''Fátima''', is a Portuguese [[association football|football club]] based in [[Fátima, Portugal|Fátima]], in the municipality of [[Ourém]]. Founded in 1966, it holds home matches at ''Estádio Papa Francisco'', with a capacity of 1,545 spectators.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://rr.sapo.pt/noticia/82734/portugal_ganha_estadio_com_nome_de_papa_francisco|title = Portugal ganha estádio com nome de Papa Francisco - Renascença|date = 4 May 2017}}</ref>

Club's home kit is dark-red for shirt, shorts and socks, with the away one being all white."}}
